## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 21 bloated prose blocks (20 leading owner docstrings and 1 ordinary full-line comment region; 3,840 base words) are confirmed across 18 paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete change history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Before-citations use `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. A path-scoped comparison through `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` found zero overlap. Implement from current `origin/main`, retain `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84` as the immutable before-image, and keep this leaf to one commit so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Boundary and immutable oracle
Below, `R` means `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler`. `D:<qualified-owner>` identifies only that owner's leading string docstring; `C:<anchor>@Lx-y` identifies one contiguous base comment region. Edit only these IDs. Every block must shrink and state current rationale/constraints; preserve cited literals and behavioral oracles.

Parse base/final source with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; replace only allowlisted leading docstring values; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact attribute-free AST equality. Tokenize independently to preserve directive/shebang text and inline/next-statement attachment. Runtime strings, inline comments, unlisted prose, executable syntax, and zero-context diff hunks outside the base spans remain exact.

## Scope — 21 editable blocks
- `R/test_explicit_assignee_resolver_65d7.py` — `D:module`; preserve the declared keyword resolver, permissive default, backend threading, and ban on attribute discovery.
- `R/test_fetch_multi_project.py` — `D:module`; preserve per-project base/enrichment fan-out and ceilings, fallback parity, dedup, and project/repo stamping.
- `R/test_fetch_paging_split.py` — `D:module`; preserve object-identical compatibility exports, one-way split, behavior/error parity, and file-size boundary.
- `R/test_fetcher_pagination_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve server-clamped pagination, returned-length advancement, stall handling, Cloud ceiling, and no silent partial snapshot.
- `R/test_field_contract_properties.py` — `D:module`; preserve registry coverage, conflict-class parity, status residue, link inversion, add-wins, and one-way gates.
- `R/test_fit_for_send.py` (2) — `D:module`, `D:test_the_fit_then_wire_derivation_has_exactly_one_body`; preserve one wire derivation, exact sent/readback key, two-pass convergence, and the structural copy census.
- `R/test_git_adapter_characterization.py` — `D:module`; preserve exact git argv and named ref/path constants at the single git seam.
- `R/test_identity_264f_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve account-id sentinel propagation, skipped fuzzy search/flag leakage, and raw reporter PUT.
- `R/test_identity_dc_inbound_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve the DC name-without-accountId guard plus invalid creation-channel compound defect and shared identity vocabulary.
- `R/test_identity_write_retention_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve no-delete recovery after identity-write failure, keyed pending retention, and later deterministic containment.
- `R/test_inbound_assignee_oracle_discriminates_5200.py` — `D:module`; preserve read-only registry observation, setup removal, production mint, and a provably red no-mint mutation.
- `R/test_inbound_rich_text_echo.py` — `D:module`; preserve lossy landed-wire comparison and once-only inbound convergence.
- `R/test_inbound_update_assignee_mint_5200.py` (2) — `D:module`, `D:test_the_differ_forwards_the_canonical_identity_with_the_assignee`; preserve canonical identity alongside the scalar and Cloud/DC key selection. The latter is at immutable L215-221, correcting stale legacy range L214-220.
- `R/test_index_lag_duplicate_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve the full crash→recover→differ→create one-issue oracle across both index-dependent sites.
- `R/test_jira_datacenter_backend_port.py` — `D:module`; preserve nine-member Protocol conformance, empty-query fail-closed behavior, and named neutral environment errors.
- `R/test_jira_dc_config_settings.py` (2) — `D:module`, `C:"AC(13) sub-requirements..."@L147-154`; preserve TLS rejection/override warnings, config-error propagation, retired-status context, verification failure, and secure `allow_insecure`.
- `R/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py` — `D:module`; preserve working AMPS flags, rejection of ineffective flags, image digest, vendored license, and loopback binding.
- `R/test_jira_dc_transport_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve TLS options-dict enforcement, registration side effect/error, secret-safe construction, and retry direction.

## Protected exclusions and consumers
All 249 other owner-docstring/full-line-comment blocks are excluded. Concise examples include `test_no_module_discovers_the_resolver_by_getattr` (8 words), `_PageClient` (9), and `test_core_field_classes_pinned` (10). Longer per-test/helper prose—pagination teeth, verified-fake shapes, identity recovery, TLS/harness controls, and `_fit_then_wire_offenders`—is load-bearing and remains exact. Preserve 19 directive tokens/attachments: 8 type-ignore tokens, 7 E402 noqas, 3 no-cover pragmas, and the registration F401 noqa.

Pytest collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the prose-policy consumer. Source-reading tests inspect production files, not these editable blocks. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 21 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`path<TAB>block-id<TAB>before-full-SHA:lines<TAB>final-full-SHA:lines<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>directives-exact<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Before citations use `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`; final citations use the full final SHA. Every after count is lower and all three verdict columns are `PASS`. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 21 allowlisted base blocks change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and current.
- [ ] Normalized AST dumps equal the immutable before-image.
- [ ] Runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Directive/shebang text and attachment remain exact.
- [ ] `HEAD^..HEAD` changes exactly all 18 file-impact paths.
- [ ] Focused pytest passes every impacted module.
- [ ] Scoped Ruff check and format verification pass.
- [ ] Repository comment hygiene passes.
- [ ] The path-scoped diff has no whitespace errors.
- [ ] Worktree-venv `make verify` passes without a timeout.
- [ ] The non-author TSV contains exactly 21 valid `PASS` rows.

## Verification
Run all seven structured DD commands: `immutable-prose-only`, `exact-leaf-paths`, `focused-tests`, `scoped-ruff`, `comment-hygiene`, `diff-integrity`, and `repository-gates`.
